title: Help with Hime Works Choice Options script.

posts.author: DeyJay5
posts.body:
I'm using this script in VX Ace:
https://himeworks.com/2013/03/choice-options/
I'm trying to set the condition that if a certain item is not in your inventory, then the option will now show. I cannot figure out what script command to call, can someone please help me. I've tried coding it the follwing ways:
hide_choice(1, "$game_items[17]")
hide_choice(1, "$game_items[17]" = false")
hide_choice(1, "$game_items[17] > 1")
How do I need to configure it so that if item 17 is not in inventory the option won't show?
